job.title: [Post] We're Hiring | Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) B2B Lightning Developer We are looking for…

tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Developer | Java, Spring Boot, B2B Commerce, OCC REST APIs & Integrations
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of experience building and supporting large enterprise B2B e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, and integrations between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Proven track record in B2B commerce data flows, headless REST web services, order management, and agile collaboration, delivering robust API integrations and enterprise e-commerce solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) B2B Lightning Developer
cover_en.hook: With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms for global organizations like Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the B2B Commerce Developer position at Tara Kumari. My deep background in B2B e-commerce architectures, RESTful API design, and core platform integrations enables me to rapidly add value to your client solutions.

bullets.label: B2B E-Commerce & Platform Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust e-commerce solutions covering product catalog management, pricing, customer account structures, and order management (OMS) for Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: API & System Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed RESTful web services and headless APIs, executing data pipelines and resolving complex integration bottlenecks across enterprise PIM, ERP, and MDM environments.

bullets.label: Data Modeling & Architecture
bullets.text: Customized data models, interceptors, and business logic using Java and Spring, optimizing database queries and refactoring backend logic to improve system performance and transaction speed.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: Analyzed complex business requirements alongside product owners and international stakeholders, writing clear functional specifications and user stories to drive agile delivery.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period (last working day 15 December 2026) and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my backend commerce expertise aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: Tara Kumari's focus on delivering high-impact B2B e-commerce solutions offers an exciting environment where my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce backend engineering, RESTful API integration, and B2B catalog management experience can drive immediate value. I am eager to apply my strong backend foundation in Java, e-commerce data flows, and cross-system integrations to support key client projects.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driven by 5+ years of building and optimizing enterprise B2B e-commerce platforms, I bring deep expertise in RESTful APIs, data pipelines, and techno-functional collaboration. I am eager to contribute my backend e-commerce background to deliver high-quality B2B solutions at Tara Kumari.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I noticed your opening for a B2B Commerce Developer at Tara Kumari. With 5+ years of enterprise backend e-commerce experience (Java, REST APIs, B2B workflows, ERP/PIM integrations), I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute to your team.
tailoring.offer: In my first months at Tara Kumari, I will bring deep expertise in B2B e-commerce workflows, RESTful API integration, and complex ERP/PIM data pipelines to ensure seamless backend delivery. My techno-functional background in requirement analysis and production support will help bridge business needs and technical execution efficiently.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for B2B Commerce Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the B2B Commerce Developer role at Tara Kumari. As a Senior E-Commerce Developer with over 5 years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful web services, and PIM/ERP integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven backend expertise in complex B2B commerce workflows.

I hold a valid German work permit, live in Karlsruhe, and am currently serving my notice period (available from 16 December 2026). Please find my CV and cover letter attached.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
